title: Polaris Publishes 2025 Geared For Good Report
summary: Polaris Inc. (NYSE: PII) today released its 2025 Geared For Good Report . The annual report highlights Polaris' ongoing efforts to support its people, riders, communities and the outdoors while advancing toward its 2035 environmental goals. "Doing business the right way and being thoughtful stewards of our industry, our people and the outdoors is core to who we are at Polaris," said Holly Spaeth, Vice President, Brand Powersports Marketing and Corporate Responsibility Committee Chair at Polaris. "This year's report reflects our commitment to being Geared For Good, highlighting how we're welcoming more people into powersports, investing in our communities, and making progress toward our long‑term environmental goals." The report is organized around Polaris' four Geared For Good pillars: THINK PRODUCT, THINK PRODUCTION, THINK PLACES, and THINK PEOPLE.
